authority: Parent integration of worker and reviewer readings, all author-side; not independent promotion verification
whole_claim_rule: Only the main source's actually retrieved content may support the bounded assertion. A compound assertion with a leg supported only by a different corroboration URL, an unread original, or an untested inference is partial-support. scoped-support means the explicitly bounded source-attribution or object statement is supported, not that every part of a civilization or question is resolved. The four tertiary mains remain unresolved for the questions' requested scholarly/dated-object legs, even though the mediated text was retrieved. Raw worker verdicts and scope labels are never rewritten.

passage_policy.key: Effective source URL (lowercase host, trailing slash stripped), whitespace-normalized locator, NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized main excerpt. Each row below is a relevance decision for that exact raw main passage, with only the explicit URL/locator overrides shown. Full derived key list is emitted in validation.json.
passage_policy.partial_support_counts: A partial-support row can carry a substantive relevant recheck without verifying the compound claim. Supported totals are not F's admission criterion.
passage_policy.corroboration: Preserved and discussed, never added to the F passage threshold; no optional-field-shape inflation.
passage_policy.museum_fields: Technical and descriptive object-record fields are non-bibliographic content; R6-03-B is a labelled field transcription, not continuous prose. Bibliography and accession-only identity do not count.
passage_policy.abstracts: R6-11-B counts the actual publisher-deposited Taube abstract prose read through Crossref, scoped to the entry's abstract attribution. Metadata surrounding it and unread article pages do not count. R6-02-A's bibliographic/abstract corroboration remains excluded.
passage_policy.independence: The five parent spotchecks are separately counted. Twenty qualifying mains are not twenty independent parent confirmations.

limits: Relevance and scope decisions are recorded judgments, not machine proof of quotation truth. The acceptance runner freezes raw records, counts eligible main keys and parent receipts, and checks regressions. It does not certify the whole corpus, authentic cultural practice, or exact upstream wire-model identity.
